div.div: ENFORCED REVOCATION TIME LIMITS SUMMARY (Section 10, ASM-098, PD-100): • Incident reporting duty: Lost device or user departure reported within 2 hours of awareness • Cloud revocation SLA: Completed within 4 hours target from report (ASM-098) • IoT broker disconnection: MQTT connection terminated in minutes via UpdateCertificate REVOKED (PD-100) • S3 Pre-signed URL expiry: Active drone upload grants expire within 15 minutes max (ASM-093) • Token invalidation: GlobalSignOut terminates refresh tokens immediately; revoked_after check cuts access tokens • Outbox key protection: Phone keystore key inaccessible without physical screen lock / biometric PIN
